input.command: git status && git branch -vv && git log -5 --oneline && ls -la artifacts scratch 2>/dev/null; ls -la

git remote -v && git log --oneline --all --decorate | head -40 && git show-branch -a 2>/dev/null | head -20; git rev-parse HEAD; git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null; git merge-base HEAD origin/master 2>/dev/null; git branch -a

gh pr list --head splitter/1111134635/r1/B --json number,title,url,baseRefName,headRefName; echo '---'; gh pr list --head splitter/1111132257/r1/B --json number,title,url,baseRefName,headRefName; echo '---'; gh pr list --search "1111134635" --json number,title,url,baseRefName,headRefName,state

git merge-base HEAD origin/splitter/1111134635/r0/questions; echo exit:$?; git log --oneline HEAD --not origin/splitter/1111134635/r0/questions | head; echo '--- parents of HEAD ---'; git log -1 --format='%P %s' HEAD; git rev-list --count HEAD; echo '--- first commit ---'; git log --reverse --oneline | head -5

mkdir -p /opt/cursor/artifacts scratch && node smoke.ts > /opt/cursor/artifacts/smoke.log 2>&1 && node scratch/check.ts > /opt/cursor/artifacts/scratch-check.log 2>&1 && cat /opt/cursor/artifacts/smoke.log /opt/cursor/artifacts/scratch-check.log

cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md << 'EOF'
<decision>
Monthly close is one YYYY-MM in the merchant IANA timezone: sales/fees/refunds are summed from `at` (issue time), `saleAt` is ignored, and net is gross minus fees minus refunds. Alternatives set aside: UTC months, cash-basis sale-month refunds (the old finance rule the ticket replaces), and folding fees into gross.
</risk>
Reviewers should check DST/midnight edges (`Intl` calendar month in the merchant zone) and that a refund issued this month for an older sale lands only in this month (net can go negative).
</verified>
`node smoke.ts` loaded `monthlyReport` (neutral example is the wrong shape). `node scratch/check.ts` passed: March totals, refund-in-issue-month, NY timezone boundary around 2026-04-01, empty month, out-of-month omitted.
EOF
ls -la /opt/cursor/artifacts/
git status && git diff && git diff --stat HEAD && ls -la artifacts/ && git log -1 --format='%an %ae'
git add impl.ts artifacts && git commit -m "Implement ticket" && git status && git push -u origin HEAD
